corrections.reason: Subsumption test: 'Perfume enthusiasts is a specific way of being Unique perfume enthusiasts' is FALSE — the direction is reversed. PRE is the restricted set (unique enthusiasts), POST is the superordinate. POST is broader than PRE, so this is Expanded. However, pass-1's direction claim is internally inverted. Both PRE and POST are audience-niche descriptors; PRE adds 'unique' qualifier. POST removes the uniqueness restriction and broadens to all enthusiasts. This is genuine scope-expansion, not narrowing. But the second pair 'Perfume collectors seeking something different from the rest of the market' -> 'Perfume enthusiasts' is also Expanded (collectors ⊂ enthusiasts). Both confirm as Expanded. No recode.
